summary: Descartes Systems Group (Nasdaq: DSGX, TSX: DSG) issued a Form 6-K press release on September 1, 2026, announcing the acquisition of Extensiv, a California-based provider of AI-enabled 3PL warehouse management and omnichannel fulfillment solutions, for approximately US $120 million in cash from cash on hand. The deal extends Descartes' warehouse and inventory management capabilities and adds omnichannel fulfillment data to its Global Logistics Network. This follows Descartes' announced acquisition of Tai on August 24, 2026. Watch for integration progress, combined 3PL capabilities, and potential accretion to Descartes' earnings.
